regime.label: Short gamma all the way to the 1110 flip with ATM IV at an 8-session low of 12.92% and 25-delta skew widening to +1.57 - protection bought into compression, a coil rather than a pin
evidence: 1110 gamma flip sits 33.1 points above spot 1076.9; cumulative net GEX is -2,170 at the 1080 strike and troughs at -4,058 at 1070, so dealers are short gamma across the whole 930-1100 corridor and hedge with the move, not against it.

12.92% ATM IV is the lowest of the last 8 sessions (range 12.92-15.01) while the +1.57 25-delta skew (14.32% put vs 12.76% call) is the widest - volatility got cheaper and its downside leg got dearer at the same time.
Put OI 29,868 against call OI 17,122 (P/C 1.74) with both sides still building (+244 puts, +230 calls) - the burden map is thickening, not unwinding, so this is Protection rather than Unwind.
910 put wall carries 10,739 OI (36% of all put open interest) but traded only 47 lots at 15.5% out of the money - it fails Vol2Vol outright, leaving 1050 (+47 OI on 99 lots) as the live support.

S50U26.today_summary: 1076.9 on the S50U26 future, down 5.2 on the day, leaves spot 6.9 points above the 1070 max pain and 3.1 points under the 1080 call wall (2,276 OI). ATM IV compressed 71 bps to 12.92%, an 8-session low, cutting the 1-sigma daily move to 8.76 points (0.81%). Cumulative net GEX is negative from 930 up to the 1110 flip and troughs at -4,058 at the 1070 strike, so the short-gamma pocket sits directly beneath spot. The 25-delta skew widened to +1.57 on 219 lots of 1090-put buying that added +90 OI - the single largest live build on the board.
what_changed: ATM IV fell 71 bps to 12.92%, an 8-session low, cutting the 1-sigma daily move to 8.76 points from 9.28.
25-delta skew widened to +1.57 from +0.88 as 219 lots of 1090 puts added +90 OI, the largest Vol2Vol-confirmed build of the session.
Near-money call resistance dropped back to the 1080 wall (2,276 OI) from 1100, with the future down 5.2 to 1076.9, leaving spot 3.1 points under the wall.
25-delta call band compressed 10 points to 1110 while the 25-delta put band held at 1040 - the implied distribution shed upside without adding downside.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Against 2026-08-04 (anchor 1082.2, IV 14.10%, skew +0.60), five sessions have compressed ATM IV by 118 bps to 12.92% while the 25-delta skew nearly tripled to +1.57 - volatility got cheaper and its downside leg got dearer at the same time. Max pain drifted up 10 points to 1070 and has now held there for five straight sessions, while near-money call resistance migrated down from 1100 to the 1080 wall, tightening the working corridor to roughly 1070-1080. The 1110 gamma flip has not moved in five sessions, so every session in this range has been traded with dealers short gamma beneath it. Open interest built on both sides (+1,991 calls, +2,098 puts) with no sign of unwind, so the structure is thickening rather than fading. Flat flip plus tightening corridor plus compressing IV plus widening put skew is the signature of a coil, and the -4,058 GEX trough at 1070 marks where a break would be amplified rather than faded.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1070 / 1040
strategies.rationale: 8.9-point debit buys the -4,058 cumulative-GEX trough at 1070, where dealers are deepest short gamma and hedge with a break rather than fading it, and it does so at an 8-session IV low; the structure also buys 12.77% vol on the 1070 put and sells 14.32% vol on the 1040 put, so the widening skew is paid for rather than paid away.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 8.9 points, the full net debit (17.5 paid on the 1070 put less 8.6 received on the 1040 put). Max value 30 points at or below 1040; breakeven 1061.1, which is 1.8x the 8.76-point 1-sigma daily move below spot.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1090, where +90 put OI built on 219 lots today - reclaiming 1090 neutralises the short-gamma pocket and puts the 1110 flip back in play.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1090 / 1120
strategies.rationale: 9.5-point debit expresses the invalidation side: the 1090-1110 corridor is also short gamma, so a reclaim of 1090 gets chased upward by the same hedging that would amplify a break down, while the short strike at 1120 sits above the 1110 flip where dealers turn long gamma and dampen the move; held alongside the put spread it is a defined-risk coil trade that only loses in full if the market expires inside the current 1070-1090 corridor.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 9.5 points, the full net debit (14.8 paid on the 1090 call less 5.3 received on the 1120 call). Max value 30 points at or above 1120; breakeven 1099.5. Run as a pair with the put spread the combined max loss is 18.4 points.
strategies.invalidation: A close below 1070, the GEX trough, which confirms the downside break and leaves this leg as dead premium.

S50U26.prediction: Base case is continued 1067-1084 chop anchored on the 1070 max pain, which has held for five sessions, but the 8.76-point 1-sigma and the -4,058 GEX trough at 1070 make a close below 1070 the asymmetric event: dealers hedging into that pocket would extend the move rather than fade it. Bias is neutral with a fat downside tail rather than directional conviction, and the +1.57 skew shows the market paying for exactly that tail. A close back above 1090 with fresh call OI building at 1100-1110 invalidates the downside tilt and turns the 1110 flip into the target.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only, not trade advice, and no position sizing is implied. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat the 1070 max pain and the 1110 gamma flip as tendencies, not guarantees. The 910 put wall's 10,739 OI is 36% of all put open interest but fails the Vol2Vol test outright (47 lots, 15.5% out of the money, IV 23.08% versus 12.92% at the money) and must not be read as live support. Defined risk is not risk-free: each debit structure above can lose 100% of the premium paid, and at 49 days to expiry theta and any further IV compression work against long-premium structures. Macro or news flow can override the option structure entirely. Data reflects the 11 Aug session, scraped 11 Aug 23:59 (+07:00).
